concerns.text: The plan claims that with an effective sample size of ≥ 800 subjects the study will have > 80 % power to detect a correlation of r = 0.05 at α = 0.05. This is mathematically incorrect: for a two‑tailed test with α = 0.05, detecting r = 0.05 requires a sample size on the order of > 10 000 to achieve 80 % power. The stated power analysis is therefore invalid and overstates the study’s sensitivity, constituting a scientific flaw in the methodology.
